lessons.title: Briathra leathana: -faidh
lessons.rule: If the last vowel of the root is broad (a, o or u), add -faidh to the root to make the future: glan becomes glanfaidh.
steps: Find the root of the verb: glan.
Look at the last vowel: a is broad, so the ending is -faidh.
Add the ending to the root: glanfaidh.
Put the verb first, then the pronoun: Glanfaidh sé an seomra ranga.

items.prompt: (Glan: mé) an seomra ranga amárach.
items.answer: Glanfaidh mé an seomra ranga amárach.

items.answer: Tógfaidh muid an bus go dtí an tIúr.

lessons.title: Briathra caola: -fidh
lessons.rule: If the last vowel of the root is slender (i or e), add -fidh to the root: cuir becomes cuirfidh.
steps: Find the root of the verb: caith.
Look at the last vowel: i is slender, so the ending is -fidh.
Add the ending to the root: caithfidh.
Put the verb first, then the pronoun: Caithfidh sé an liathróid chuig an réiteoir.

example.prompt: (Caith: sé) an liathróid chuig an réiteoir.
example.answer: Caithfidh sé an liathróid chuig an réiteoir.

more.answer: Bainfidh sé an féar sa ghairdín.

items.answer: Blaisfidh mé an píotsa.

lessons.title: Ceist agus freagra: An + urú, Ní + séimhiú
lessons.en: Answering a question in the future: yes and no
lessons.rule: Answer a question by repeating the verb with the right pronoun (Glanfaidh mé), and for no put Ní in front and add h (Ní ghlanfaidh mé). The question itself has An and eclipsis (An nglanfaidh tú?); l, n, r and s show no eclipsis.
steps: Take the verb from the question and remove the eclipsis: nglanfaidh becomes glanfaidh.
The question asks tú, so answer with mé: Glanfaidh mé.
For no, put Ní in front and add h: Ní ghlanfaidh mé.
Write both answers after the question: Glanfaidh mé / Ní ghlanfaidh mé.

example.prompt: An nglanfaidh tú an seomra ranga?
example.answer: An nglanfaidh tú an seomra ranga? Glanfaidh mé / Ní ghlanfaidh mé.

more.prompt: An ndruidfidh tú doras an bhus?
more.answer: An ndruidfidh tú doras an bhus? Druidfidh mé / Ní dhruidfidh mé.

lessons.hint: Repeat the verb for yes; Ní + h for no.

lessons.title: Briathra a thosaíonn ar ghuta nó ar f
lessons.en: Verbs beginning with a vowel or f
lessons.rule: A verb that begins with a vowel never changes after An or Ní: An ólfaidh tú? Ní ólfaidh mé. A verb that begins with f takes bhf after An and fh after Ní: An bhfágfaidh tú? Ní fhágfaidh mé.
steps: Take the verb from the question: íocfaidh.
It begins with a vowel, so nothing is added: Íocfaidh mé.
For no, put Ní in front and leave the verb as it is: Ní íocfaidh mé.
Write both answers after the question: Íocfaidh mé / Ní íocfaidh mé.

example.prompt: An íocfaidh tú as an ticéad?
example.answer: An íocfaidh tú as an ticéad? Íocfaidh mé / Ní íocfaidh mé.

more.answer: An bhfanfaidh tú sa Ghaeltacht? Fanfaidh mé / Ní fhanfaidh mé.

lessons.hint: Vowel: no change. F: An bhf-, Ní fh-.

lessons.title: Ceist do sibh: freagra le muid
lessons.en: Questions to sibh: answer with muid
lessons.rule: When the question is put to sibh, answer for the group with the verb followed by muid: An gcuirfidh sibh? Cuirfidh muid / Ní chuirfidh muid.
steps: Take the verb from the question and remove the eclipsis: nglanfaidh becomes glanfaidh.
The question asks sibh, so answer with muid: Glanfaidh muid.
For no, put Ní in front and add h: Ní ghlanfaidh muid.
Write both answers after the question: Glanfaidh muid / Ní ghlanfaidh muid.

lessons.hint: sibh in the question, muid in the answer.

lessons.title: Ceist a scríobh don fhreagra
lessons.en: Writing the question for an answer
lessons.rule: To write the question, take away Ní and its h, put An in front and eclipse the verb where you can, and swap mé for tú or muid for sibh: Ní chuirfidh mé becomes An gcuirfidh tú?
steps: Take away Ní and the h: chuirfidh becomes cuirfidh.
Put An in front and eclipse the verb: An gcuirfidh.
Swap mé for tú and add a question mark: An gcuirfidh tú?

example.answer: Ní chuirfidh mé. An gcuirfidh tú?

lessons.hint: Drop Ní, add An + eclipsis, swap mé for tú.

lessons.title: An saorbhriathar: -far agus -fear
lessons.rule: When you do not say who does the action, add -far to a broad root or -fear to a slender root, with no pronoun after it: glan becomes glanfar, cuir becomes cuirfear.
steps: Find the root: druid.
The last vowel is slender, so the ending is -fear: druidfear.
Put it first, with no pronoun after it: Druidfear an scoil go luath amárach.

example.answer: Druidfear an scoil go luath amárach.
